topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: My heart's in a clench, the way the soil feels when winter grips it too hard. I wrote about the land, the toil, the saints watching over our seeds. It was meant just for my application, to explain why studying agriculture means more to me than to most. Now they've taken those words, made them an example for all to see. What if they think I boast too much? What if they see my worries and think less of me? This harvest, I fear, might lay bare more than just my thoughts. I didn’t mean to show all that. Saints preserve me, what has this brought unto me?
